scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run generate:all && npm run copy:fonts && npm run copy:generated && npm run create:index
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/text dist/color dist/effect
scripts.generate:all: npm run generate:text && npm run generate:color && npm run generate:effect
scripts.copy:generated: cp text/text-styles.css dist/text/ && cp color/colorStyles.css dist/color/ && cp effect/effectStyles.css dist/effect/
